list: Leonida Ledger data: the official 55 trophies. Names, descriptions and grades are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase. Hidden flags and progress targets follow the same public listings. Guides are original to this app.

sources.label: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophy list
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI (PSN) trophies

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum, and it asks for patience rather than skill: clear every other entry in this ledger and it unlocks on its own. Work through the roadmap in order, keep the possibly missable meditation trophy in mind from Chapter 1, and treat the 100 percent completion gold as the long final stretch. When the counter in this tracker reads 54 of 55, this one is the last to fall.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Vice Got a Price!
Exophase trophy page for Vice Got a Price!

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from start to finish. It introduces the world and the controls, so simply follow the on-screen prompts and let the mission play out; the trophy pops when the mission wraps up. It cannot be missed because the story cannot advance without it.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Just Like Paradise
Exophase trophy page for Just Like Paradise

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every main mission in Chapter 1 and this chapter trophy is yours. While you are in this chapter, take the first meditation spot the moment it is offered at home: other guides report that spot may close off afterwards, and it belongs to Positive Mental Attitude. Keep a manual save at the chapter start as insurance.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Paradise Lost
Exophase trophy page for Paradise Lost

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete the main missions of Chapter 2. The chapter trophy unlocks automatically as the story moves on, so no side detour is required; use the chapter to open up the map, meet the second protagonist properly, and start sampling activities for Master of None on the side.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for T**s Ass Drug Money
Exophase trophy page for T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: See Chapter 3 through to its final main mission. Like the other chapter trophies this one is story-locked in the good sense: it cannot be skipped or missed, and it lands as the narrative hands you Chapter 4. Side strands for strangers begin to pile up around now, so start clearing them between story beats.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Vice City, Baby!
Exophase trophy page for Vice City, Baby!

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the main missions of Chapter 4. By this point most of Leonida and most activity types should be open, which makes it a good moment to sweep up races, range challenges and collectibles before the finale. The trophy itself needs nothing beyond completing the chapter.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Top Of The World, Ma
Exophase trophy page for Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission and the credits-side gold is yours. Before you start it, park a manual save, finish any chapter-sensitive side content you care about, and make sure the Chapter 1 meditation spot is already done. After the finale the free roam cleanup for 100 percent completion begins.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for You Gotta Know When to Get Off
Exophase trophy page for You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to its conclusion. It sits on the main path, so it unlocks simply by progressing the campaign; follow the mission markers, complete each objective as it is given, and the trophy lands at the mission complete screen.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Trust
Exophase trophy page for Trust

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a set-piece story mission. Prepare the way you would for any heist: full health, armour and ammo before the start marker, then work through the setup and escape beats the mission gives you. Completion, not a score or a time, is all the trophy asks for.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Break the Bank
Exophase trophy page for Break the Bank

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play when it appears on the main path. There is no optional condition attached to it: start the mission, follow its objectives through, and the trophy unlocks as the mission ends.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Family Matters
Exophase trophy page for Family Matters

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It is part of the campaign spine, so keep following the main markers and it will come to you; the trophy pops on completion regardless of how cleanly the mission went.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for DWNFALL
Exophase trophy page for DWNFALL

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, the story mission set around the airport authority. Play it through on the main path and the trophy is automatic. The airport area is also where Catch Me If You Can later becomes possible, so learn the layout while you are here.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Hi-Jacked
Exophase trophy page for Hi-Jacked

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play Operation Savage Glory to the end. This named operation is a required story beat, so the trophy needs no hunting: stock up before you start, follow the objective chain, and it unlocks at mission complete.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Snow Storm
Exophase trophy page for Snow Storm

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100 percent on the in-game completion counter. The counter draws on the same pool this ledger tracks: story and side strands, activities, collectibles, exploration and purchases. Use the game's completion checklist alongside this tracker, mop up category by category, and expect this gold to be one of the last two trophies you earn, right before the platinum.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for A Long Road
Exophase trophy page for A Long Road

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts in total. Stunt opportunities are scattered across Leonida as ramps, jumps and marked stunt spots, so weave them into normal travel instead of grinding them in one sitting: take every ramp you pass, and use a fast, sturdy vehicle or bike. The counter in this tracker mirrors the target PlayStation tracks, so log each session's haul as you go.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Cunning Stunts
Exophase trophy page for Cunning Stunts

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once: PlayStation tracks 9 types. You do not need to win or score, just start each one properly at least once: a race, a drone race, a shooting range challenge, a fishing challenge, an arcade game, a stunt, a challenge, a meditation spot and a round of bowling cover the spirit of the list. This is one of the cheapest bronzes in the game, so grab it early.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Master of None
Exophase trophy page for Master of None

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Learn each weapon category's scoring rhythm first with a practice run, then chase gold: accuracy streaks matter more than raw speed on most ranges. Work range by range and tick each gold off in this tracker; if one challenge resists, move on and return with a steadier hand rather than burning out on it.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for The Shootist
Exophase trophy page for The Shootist

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. A win, not just a finish, is required, so learn each course with a sighting lap, cut the racing line through the gates, and restart freely when a run goes wrong. Clear locations region by region so none hide at the end.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Top Fun
Exophase trophy page for Top Fun

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; repeats of the same race do not add to the count. Spread your wins across the race types and locations the map offers, bring a vehicle suited to each class, and use this tracker to note which events you have already won so the last few are easy to find.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Earn Cash, Not Kudos
Exophase trophy page for Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take on Cal in a fishing challenge and finish ahead of him. Start the challenge from the fishing spots where Cal appears, learn the cast-and-reel timing on a practice fish or two, then keep your haul steady for the whole round. One win is all it takes, and the challenge can be retried.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Baited My Tackle
Exophase trophy page for Baited My Tackle

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game at any arcade cabinet you find in the world. Completion is the bar, not a high score: pick the shortest cabinet game you come across, play it to its end screen, and the bronze is yours. It also counts as one of the activity types for Master of None.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Stick Fiddler
Exophase trophy page for Stick Fiddler

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's side strand and finish its final mission. Strands unlock in steps as the story advances, so check back with Andy whenever a new marker appears and clear each part promptly; strands like this also feed the Strangers & Freaks silver and the 100 percent counter.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Road to Rehabilitation
Exophase trophy page for Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's strand through to its final mission. Follow each of Kenton's markers as they surface during the campaign, and finish the strand rather than leaving its last job hanging; the trophy pops at the end of that final mission.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for This Was No Boat Accident
Exophase trophy page for This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand by completing its final mission. Billy's jobs appear progressively, so keep an eye on the map between story missions and mop each one up as it unlocks. Completing the strand also moves Strangers & Freaks and overall completion forward.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for The Lone Rider
Exophase trophy page for The Lone Rider

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Fully complete 8 stranger mission strands anywhere in Leonida. The named strands in this ledger, for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone among them, are the backbone: a strand only counts when its final mission is done, so always finish what you start. Track finished strands here until the silver lands.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Strangers & Freaks
Exophase trophy page for Strangers & Freaks

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: See Randy's strand through its final mission. Randy's jobs unlock in stages alongside story progress; clear each stage as it appears so the finale is waiting for you in the cleanup phase rather than buried under newer markers.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Supply & Demand
Exophase trophy page for Supply & Demand

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of Tyrone's strand. As with the other named strands, work each of Tyrone's markers in order as the campaign opens them up, and the trophy unlocks when the last job in the chain is complete.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Spin On This!
Exophase trophy page for Spin On This!

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida; PlayStation tracks the count, so tick each spot off in this tracker as you find it. POSSIBLY MISSABLE — an inference, not a confirmed fact: other guides flag this as the one trophy that may be missable, because the first meditation spot is offered at home in Chapter 1 and is reported to become unavailable after that chapter. Treat that warning seriously: meditate at the first spot the first time it is offered, do every later spot the moment it appears, and keep a manual save at the start of each chapter as a safety net. Later spots need both protagonists playable together, which opens up as the story advances.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Positive Mental Attitude
Exophase trophy page for Positive Mental Attitude
Missable warning as reported by other guides (an inference from the Chapter 1 spot, not a confirmed fact)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take Bret's hunting job and bring down the unique animal it names. Follow Bret's strand until the hunt unlocks, track the animal using the clues and area the mission gives you, and finish the hunt cleanly; the trophy unlocks when Bret's unique quarry is dealt with.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Fair Game
Exophase trophy page for Fair Game

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida, so pick them up whenever a detour puts one in reach, and focus on finishing sets rather than scattering effort: complete your nearest set first, then the next. Note completed sets here; the silver lands with the third finished set.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Don't Touch My Deck
Exophase trophy page for Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations. This is a pure coverage grind: whenever you arrive somewhere new, do it there once and move on. Pair it with The Goodtime State exploration and the stunt hunt so the trips overlap, and log your count here after each session to watch the silver approach.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for You WAiNKer!
Exophase trophy page for You WAiNKer!

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges surface all over the activity pool, so the efficient route is variety: rotate races, ranges, stunts and side activities instead of repeating one favourite, and the count climbs as a by-product of the rest of this roadmap. Log progress here as you go.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for One Last Thing
Exophase trophy page for One Last Thing

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, raise the heat to 4 stars, then break line of sight and lose the wanted level completely. A reliable method: commit enough mayhem in a populated area to hit 4 stars, then dive into alleys, tunnels or off-road cover and stay hidden until the stars drain. Both of you must come through it together.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Hot Together
Exophase trophy page for Hot Together

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping a wanted level alive the whole time. Pick a tight cluster of shops, bring a fast getaway car, and move directly from till to till: if the stars fully drain between shops the chain breaks. Plan the route first, then execute it in one run.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Retail Therapy
Exophase trophy page for Retail Therapy

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. A vehicle counts when you encounter and register it in the world, so make a habit of hopping into unfamiliar models you spot parked or in traffic, and visit different districts: rich areas, docks, farms and airfields each carry their own traffic pool. This pairs naturally with exploration for The Goodtime State.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Whip It Good
Exophase trophy page for Whip It Good

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Set the moment up before you trigger it: gather a group of five or more hostiles in open ground, top up your health, then activate Focus and work the group quickly, nearest threats first. Gang operations and heist escapes give natural clusters if free roam is quiet.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Gunslinger
Exophase trophy page for Gunslinger

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave VCIA, the airport, in a way the schedule never planned: take an aircraft or vehicle out of the airport without following a normal departure. Head to the airport in free roam, get yourself onto the airfield, and depart on your own terms. The official description is deliberately vague, so treat any unplanned exit from VCIA as the attempt and the trophy confirms the right one.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Catch Me If You Can
Exophase trophy page for Catch Me If You Can

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get involved with a Rhino tank. The description hints at heat, in both senses: find a Rhino, military hardware that appears around military sites and at high wanted levels, and take it for a spin or survive an encounter with one. Raising a serious wanted level near military ground is the most direct way to bring a Rhino to you.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Challenging Tank
Exophase trophy page for Challenging Tank

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and get away without ever being detected. Scout the store first: note staff, cameras and exits, enter quietly, keep the job silent and fast, and leave before any alarm state counts as detection. If you are spotted, walk away, let things cool down, and try the next store fresh.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Sneakthief
Exophase trophy page for Sneakthief

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time; a vault only counts once you have got away. Treat each bank as a mini-heist: case the building, plan the exit route, stage a fast car, and vary which banks you hit so the pattern stays fresh. Log each successful escape here until the silver pays out.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Maximum Withdrawal
Exophase trophy page for Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hold up an armored truck and escape with the take. Armored trucks travel the roads of Leonida; when you spot one, stop it, crack it open by the method the game allows, grab the money and lose the response. One successful truck is all the trophy needs.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for A Classic Blitz Play
Exophase trophy page for A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida: PlayStation tracks 52 areas. Sweep the map district by district, clearing the fog from cities, keys, swamps and countryside alike, and chase any grey patches left after the story. Pair the sweep with vehicle discovery, WAiNK It stops and meditation spots so one long road trip serves four trophies.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for The Goodtime State
Exophase trophy page for The Goodtime State

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation run by each of the 9 gangs. Every gang holds its own ground, so this doubles as a tour of Leonida's underworld: hit one operation per gang, note the gang off here, and move on. If you cannot tell whose operation you found, clear it anyway and check the counter; coverage, not repetition, is the goal.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Pest Control
Exophase trophy page for Pest Control

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to the Ocean Beach strip, find a bar or spot that serves drinks, and take the moment the trophy describes. It is a pause-and-breathe trophy: slow down on the beachfront, order the drink, and enjoy the view until it pops.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for In The Beginning…
Exophase trophy page for In The Beginning…

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight out through a vehicle showroom's glass, in classic style. Pick a showroom with a car inside and a window worth leaving through, get in, and accelerate out through the storefront rather than the door. It is a deliberate, joyful stunt: one clean smash-and-exit should do it.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Capital Offense
Exophase trophy page for Capital Offense

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the follow-through moment it hosts. The wording points at something specific happening at that alley rather than ordinary bowling, so explore the location, interact with what you find there, and see the moment through. It also sits naturally beside your first bowling game for Master of None.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Let’s Go Bowling
Exophase trophy page for Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: This hidden bronze has a deliberately cryptic description about a partnership with mass appeal. It is tied to the two protagonists working together, so the honest advice is to keep playing partnered content, story and side activities alike, with both characters together, and it will surface as their partnership reaches a public-facing moment. The description alone does not pin down a single step, and this guide will not invent one.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Personal Best
Exophase trophy page for Personal Best

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices that register: PlayStation tracks a count up to 500. The description frames it as decisions with consequences, for better or worse, so engage with the choice prompts the game offers instead of skipping past them, across story, strands and free roam. It accumulates over a full playthrough; log your count here and let the platinum run carry you to the target.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Actions Speak Louder
Exophase trophy page for Actions Speak Louder

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then succeed at it on the second attempt. The description, second time's the charm, points at a retry-then-succeed moment: when an attempt at an activity, challenge or job goes wrong, immediately run it back and complete it. Deliberately flubbing a first try at a short repeatable activity and then clearing it is the controlled way to trigger it.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Bad Luck, I Guess
Exophase trophy page for Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness one of Leonida's strange moments. The description is a reaction, not a task list: something odd happens and this is the trophy for being there. Explore off the beaten path, especially remote and rural corners at odd hours, follow up rumours and unusual encounters, and when the game shows you something inexplicable, stay and watch it play out.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for The Truth Is Out There
Exophase trophy page for The Truth Is Out There

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock a pedestrian down with a melee drive-by: strike someone from a moving vehicle with a melee attack so they go down like a bowling pin. Line up a lone pedestrian on a quiet street, ride or drive past at moderate speed, and swing as you pass. One clean connection is enough; pick your spot away from heavy traffic and police attention.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Ten Pin
Exophase trophy page for Ten Pin

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from the criminal economy, robberies and operations, so feed every haul through your laundering contacts rather than spending it raw. It is a totals trophy: steady play through Stage 5's crime list builds most of it, and this tracker holds the running figure.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Dime on the Dollar
Exophase trophy page for Dime on the Dollar

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops. Every legitimate purchase counts toward the pot: vehicles, weapons, clothing, property extras and services. Do not hoard cash on a trophy run; buy what the other trophies need, garages included, and this bronze lands as a by-product before the endgame money trophies finish.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Treat Yo Self
Exophase trophy page for Treat Yo Self

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties on the map. Garages unlock for purchase as the game opens up; sweep the property listings, buy each garage as funds allow, and save the priciest for the money-rich endgame. Tick each purchase off here; the eighth key turns the trophy.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for Little Boxes
Exophase trophy page for Little Boxes

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you acquire a vehicle you intend to keep, register it in the app straight away rather than leaving it informal. Ten keepers accumulate quickly across a platinum run, especially while discovering vehicles for Whip It Good; register the best of each class as you find them.
sources: PSNProfiles trophy page for On the Spot
Exophase trophy page for On the Spot
